text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having put on a performance truly worthy 
of heralding "the dawn of a new era," TM 
Opera O calls out to Meisho Doto up in the 
stands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I was waiting only for you"—that 
declaration served as the final push for 
Meisho Doto to finally break out of her 
shell after a long, long period of 
preparation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Upon returning to the Academy after the 
race, Meisho Doto had already dashed off 
to train, still wearing her school 
uniform.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her, Admire Vega was also inspired 
and expressed her desire to start running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At last, all four stood together. The 
excitement of the Senior Class was only 
just beginning. It felt like a herald of 
what was to come.
